PROJECT FILE / Design & development

Wheelchair Leg Raiser

Designing around a client’s needs and the wheelchair they already use.

Product development · CAD · Team leadership

The need

Our GNG 2101 team is developing a wheelchair leg raiser for clients whose disabilities prevent them from lifting their legs independently.

My contribution

I lead the team and manage our work. For me, leadership means understanding the people on the team and helping them do their best. We are in development, working through CAD designs and economic constraints.

The central constraint

The product needs to be compatible with our client’s existing wheelchair. That requirement guides our design choices alongside cost and the client’s needs. I spend approximately four hours per week on the course outside class.
